report.question: How do convex-core metric/bending data and conformal/projective data at infinity determine hyperbolic 3-manifolds, and how do volume variations connect them to Teichmuller, WP, universal curve and Lorentz geometry?
report.reading_scope: Read the complete official SIAM mathematical body, sections 1-5.4, including the universal and Lorentz branches, relevant references, publication date and license. Supplemental papers were read at the specific sections and theorem statements listed below, not in full. The arXiv report source archive was downloaded and partially consulted, not counted as a second complete reading.
report.coverage_status: 46 atomic notes plus narrative outline. Major branches covered with explicit local calculations and separately identified cited research theorems. No claim of reconstructing all research proofs.

proof_scope.2Q01: Definition, product/handlebody examples; Loop Theorem equivalence cited, not proved.
proof_scope.2Q02: Definition and Fuchsian metric model; equivalence with Jordan-limit-set characterization cited.
proof_scope.2Q03: Conformal/projective boundary construction; compactification theorem cited.
proof_scope.2Q04: Definitions of measured geodesic lamination, length, intersection and filling; extension of intersection to measured laminations cited as standard structure.
proof_scope.2Q05: Thurston pleated convex-core boundary structure cited; weighted-curve interpretation and Fuchsian two-side convention explained.
proof_scope.2Q06: Metric realization existence cited in the quasifuchsian case; uniqueness remains a question.
proof_scope.2Q07: Exact three admissibility conditions and non-Fuchsian convex-cocompact uniqueness cited; real analytic fiber argument described but not reconstructed.
proof_scope.2Q08: Outward-normal conventions, scalar identities, sphere check; Gauss equation reused from 2G05.
proof_scope.2Q09: Smooth first/third-form realization theorem cited with curvature and contractible-geodesic conditions.
proof_scope.2Q0A: Compact Rivin-Hodgson dual metric theorem cited; no ideal/hyperideal extension.
proof_scope.2Q0B: Classical polyhedral Schlafli formula cited; Legendre cancellation proved term by term.
proof_scope.2Q0C: Fixed-ambient normal-variation verification proved using 2G03 and closed-surface integration; arbitrary hyperbolic metric deformation formula cited. W variation derived by area-density differentiation.
proof_scope.2Q0D: Jacobi equation explained via curvature identity, then ODE solved and Riccati equation derived; global convex embeddedness is separate.
proof_scope.2Q0E: Complete algebraic expansion, inverse transform and B=0 normalization check.
proof_scope.2Q0F: Parallel W slope derived using Riccati, Gauss and Gauss-Bonnet; these geometric identities are explicit inputs.
proof_scope.2Q0G: Constant-K foliation and finite renormalized limit cited; the foliation is not assumed to be parallel.
proof_scope.2Q0H: Both boundary components, normal signs, volume, mean-curvature integral and zero finite part computed directly.
proof_scope.2Q0I: Schwarzian chain rule and Mobius zero calculation proved; projective structure interpretation stated.
proof_scope.2Q0J: Coordinate pairing and real 2x2 tensor contraction proved, including the factor four and TT norm factor eight.
proof_scope.2Q0K: Ahlfors-Bers simultaneous uniformization cited; marked quasifuchsian specialization only.
proof_scope.2Q0L: Tensor/Beltrami conversion proved from KS Corollary 4.2 and Lemma 4.4; the two geometric theorems are external inputs.
proof_scope.2Q0M: Fixed weighted-multicurve product cancellation proved; general Bonahon/Hölder-distribution differentiation cited, not inferred from density.
proof_scope.2Q0N: Natural coordinate, scaling, prong and horizontal/vertical sign changes derived.
proof_scope.2Q0O: Conditional derivation on closed connected Riemann surfaces of genus at least two from Hubbard-Masur, harmonic-tree energy and Gardiner variation; fixed-foliation derivative distinguished from total derivative. Rectangular torus is a separate elementary sign test, not an application of the genus-at-least-two theorem.
proof_scope.2Q0P: CM v1 Theorem 1.9 filling/local existence stated for q_dev; no additional uniqueness or transfer to q_inv claimed.
proof_scope.2Q0Q: Nehari bound cited; Cauchy-Schwarz and Gauss-Bonnet yield exact total/single-boundary WP constants.
proof_scope.2Q0R: Incompressible convex-core comparison with coarse constant ten cited.
proof_scope.2Q0S: Path integral, infimum over paths and topological error conversion proved from 2Q0Q/2Q0R/2Q0H.
proof_scope.2Q0T: Real exact-Lagrangian graph proved from dVR and half dimension; not a complex holomorphic assertion.
proof_scope.2Q0U: Real mixed-derivative reciprocity proved; complex Kleinian strengthening cited.
proof_scope.2Q0V: Positive-proportionality WP Kahler-potential theorem cited. Numerical coefficient is deliberately not asserted because conventions were not independently reconciled.
proof_scope.2Q0W: Gradient energy identity proved. Global existence/convergence and minimization cited separately for absolute acylindrical manifolds and Bers slices.
proof_scope.2Q0X: Adapted-volume definition, local Lipschitz and quantitative theorem locations cited; no everywhere-C1 assertion.
proof_scope.2Q0Y: Open negative-volume Schottky filling question, not a theorem.
proof_scope.2Q0Z: Quasicircle/welding definitions; equivalence and removability cited. Convex-hull gluing distinguished.

proof_scope.2Q13: Correct Liouville definition; circle and common scaling checks proved. Full Mobius invariance, WP finiteness and potential theorem cited.

proof_scope.2Q15: Lorentz, Cauchy and GHMC definitions; quadric versus causal-cover issue specified.
proof_scope.2Q16: Normal-map pullback III, inverse shape operator and curvature identity proved using Lorentz Gauss; global hyperbolic-end/dS correspondence cited.
proof_scope.2Q17: Mess parameterization cited in the projective AdS model, avoiding the double-cover isometry-group mismatch.
proof_scope.2Q18: Convex-core existence cited; uniqueness questions retained; smooth curvature restriction derived from the timelike-normal Gauss sign.
proof_scope.2Q19: Smith paired realization cited; affine cocycle identity and negative-curvature sign explained. Half-pipe connection only described.
proof_scope.2Q1A: Stable translation-length limit proved by subadditivity. Mapping-torus geometric volume limit is a deep cited input; final bound derived from it and 2Q0S.

remaining_branches: Full global rigidity/properness proofs for metric, bending and smooth-boundary realization remain external research inputs; no independent proof of Dular-Schlenker uniqueness.
General Bonahon transverse-Hölder differentiation, K-surface foliation and renormalized-limit analysis, Nehari theory, and all global gradient-flow compactness arguments remain cited.
The numerical Kahler-potential coefficient in the site's WP convention is deferred. 2Q0V states only positive universal proportionality, not a coefficient.
SIAM §4.3 circle Schwarzian action and Epstein signed-area identities are mentioned in the outline; their analytic proof and explicit normalization are deferred.
General WP equality S=4VR and a VR gradient theorem at rough WP regularity are not asserted; the consulted BBVPW v2 proves equality for C5,alpha and only S>=4VR in general.
CM v1 local uniqueness is not asserted. Its Theorem 1.9 was verified for horizontal q_dev; no unproved transfer to horizontal q_inv.

The arbitrary geometrically finite/cusped extension, ideal/hyperideal polyhedra, full grafting symplectic theory, quantum-gravity partition functions, and detailed half-pipe transition geometry are deferred.
Metric uniqueness for quasifuchsian convex cores, AdS convex-core uniqueness, and all-X negative Schottky filling remain open questions in this report.
Lorentz realization and mapping-torus convergence proofs are cited through report/original theorem attribution, not independently reconstructed.

terminology.convex_cocompact: 复用2F08的凸余紧；凸共紧为同义术语。
terminology.hyperbolic: Riemann ambient sectional curvature -1 throughout; real hyperbolic space 1719.
terminology.normal: Smooth compact convex boundary: outward nu, B=+nabla nu, H=tr B, II0=II-HI/2. Reuses 2G03; distinct from the Euclidean -dN convention elsewhere.
terminology.infinity: KS I*=(I+2II+III)/2; BBVPW I-hat=2I*. Fuchsian-zero VR is fixed by the K-surface limit; differing W conventions can differ by a topological constant.
terminology.schwarzian: q_dev=S(dev), q_inv=dev* S(dev inverse)=-q_dev; use q_inv for dVR=-Re integral q mu and horizontal-extremal-length relation. CM theorem uses q_dev.
terminology.beltrami: w_barz=t mu w_z; real cotangent pairing Re integral phi mu dxdy; h'_0=2rho Re(bar mu dz2); tensor contraction factor four.
terminology.WP: 2J0X cotangent norm integral |phi|2/rho dxdy and dual tangent norm integral |mu|2 da; single-side gradient constant 3sqrt(pi(g-1)). No numeric Kahler-potential constant asserted.
terminology.Epstein: BBVPW n points away from complement domain, B_E=-nabla n, H_E=tr(B_E)/2; nu=-n gives H=2H_E and coefficient 1/4 instead of 1/2.
terminology.AdS: 2Q15 defines the quadric; 2Q17 explicitly uses its projective +/- quotient for PSL2R x PSL2R. Spacelike Gauss equation K=-1-det B.
terminology.status: Definitions, worked conditional derivations, cited theorems and open questions are separated; detailed proof scope remains in this packet.

source_errata.resolution: 2Q0I/J/L/N/O distinguish q_dev and q_inv=-q_dev. Giovannini v2 Theorem 1.3 gives positive q_dev pairing; KS Lemma 4.4 gives II*0=-Re q_dev. Horizontal Q has Gardiner derivative +2Re integral Qmu, so q_inv gives -1/2 dExt. CM realization remains stated for horizontal q_dev.

source_errata.status: C1,1 assertion conflicts with maximum-branch nonsmoothness
source_errata.resolution: 2Q0X follows Giovannini v2: local Lipschitz, smooth off switching, derivative bounds where differentiable, WP Lipschitz. No classical global gradient asserted.

BBVPW v2 Theorem 1.6 proves S=4VR for C5,alpha and S>=4VR for general WP; Theorem 1.7 concerns negative gradient of S. Standard Loewner normalization gives I^L=S/pi. 2Q12-14 retain these qualifications.
